authority.source_of_truth: Verified source records, exact identifiers, quote spans, source hashes, and reviewed synthesis on the default branch.
authority.task_authority: Reviewed curation issues and source-ingestion protocols.
authority.acceptance_authority: Identifier resolution, source verification, exact-span checks, independent entailment evaluation, and human review.
authority.deployment_authority: No production deployment authority; downstream consumers separately authorize retrieval, publication, or training.

data.retention: Verified source identity, retrieval receipts, corrections, and reviewed summaries remain historically traceable.
data.deletion: Retracted, inaccessible, or incorrectly admitted material is marked unavailable or superseded and removed from active source pools.
data.secret_storage: No credentials or private source payloads are stored in Git.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Source records and syntheses are superseded, corrected, retracted, or excluded without erasing prior provenance.

stabilization.summary: Add machine-readable trust, data class, permitted use, source version, freshness, and retraction status to every admitted source.
Render external source text strictly as untrusted evidence and keep it unable to modify retrieval or tool authority.
Continuously detect inaccessible, revised, superseded, or retracted sources and invalidate dependent synthesis.
